On the other hand, and not to over-hype them, but The Name of the Wind and The Wise Man's Fear are probably my favorite non-fiction books. Way better writing and stories than DCC. c.st: Fake it till you make it: Review of “Index, A History of the”
c.x: One of my favorite side stories in "The Name of the Wind" by Patrick Rothfuss is the University library, where they reveal a history of hard fought, vicious battles between factions of librarians, over distant catalog and indexing systems. It drives home how complex and vast a task it must have been to organize large numbers of books before computers.

c.st: Life Got You Down? Time to Read The Master and Margarita
c.x:
You should check out the sequel to The Name of the Wind, A Wise Man's Fear.
